project_info.theme: Airbus alumni distribution across French universities and schools
project_info.color_palette: Airbus Blue, White, Sky Gray, Soft Cyan

main_subject.detail: A clean corporate infographic centered on a large rounded white label reading 'AIRBUS', followed by five horizontal paired boxes listing French institutions on the left and alumni counts on the right.
main_subject.style: Minimal corporate infographic design with clean logo placement, flat white cards, soft blurred aviation-industrial background, and simple data hierarchy.

composition_elements.text:
AIRBUS
Université de Toulouse - 1712 alumni
ISAE SUPAERO - 1208 alumni
tbs education INSPIRING EDUCATION INSPIRING LIFE - 662 alumni
ENAC - 562 alumni
INSA Institut National des Sciences Appliquées Toulouse - 547 alumni
items: Top Left: No extra headline, just a centered rounded white box containing the blue word 'AIRBUS'.
Top Right: Blank soft sky-and-building background continuing behind the list.
Bottom Left: Five white institutional logo boxes stacked vertically with Université de Toulouse, ISAE SUPAERO, tbs education, ENAC, and INSA Toulouse.
Bottom Right: Five matching white boxes containing blue alumni counts aligned to each institution.
Center/Background: Light blue blurred industrial or airport-like facade backdrop with clean corporate spacing.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Flat even lighting, low-shadow infographic clarity, subtle background blur, and crisp logo readability.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality corporate infographic poster for Airbus alumni education sources. Centerpiece is a large rounded white title box reading 'AIRBUS', with five stacked institution rows showing French university logos on the left and blue alumni counts on the right. Background is a soft blurred light-blue industrial facade. Surrounding elements: Université de Toulouse 1712 alumni, ISAE SUPAERO 1208 alumni, tbs education 662 alumni, ENAC 562 alumni, and INSA Toulouse 547 alumni. Technical style: vector-style corporate infographic poster, soft neutral daylight graphic composite, crisp logo readability, 8k resolution, highly detailed.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: This is a clean data post, so keep the design restrained and corporate. The exact institution names and alumni counts are the key fidelity requirement; do not embellish with extra icons or decorative objects.
